hotels.title: Historic Marseille Escape in the Heart of Old Port
hotels.description: Experience the timeless elegance of sunny France with a stay in Marseille, the oldest city in France. Nestled in the historic Vieux-Port district, this grand haven built in 1816 is steps from the lively Le Panier neighborhood, famous for its winding streets, colorful markets, and cozy cafes. After a day of discovery, retreat to your elegantly designed room and relax beneath the stars that light up the sky over the Old Port. When you're ready to explore, the hotel’s prime location provides easy access to the city's must-see sights, including Notre-Dame de la Garde and the iconic modernist architecture of Le Corbusier’s Cité Radieuse.
